content.content: The markers interface reads the file whole: the read yields `.deccy/markers.json`'s contents as they stand — the whole file, never a part of it.
content.rationale: S2-markers (`ppmvwrlu`) fixes the file and that it is both read and written; the whole-file read is the separate commitment about the read's form. The file is one document, rewritten whole on every bracketed operation and every restore, so a read that yielded only part of it would hand the caller a torn document to make sense of. Reading whole makes the read the file's contents.
